name: Hiking Kemonomimi
source:
Takumi invited his friends on their spring break for a hiking trip. While decided to stroll alone, he stumbled across a humanoid cross-bred. The more he discovers about her, the more madness and paranoia building up and she is not going to let him go.

[From [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/hiking-kemonomimi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Takumi邀请朋友们趁春假一起去徒步旅行。他决定独自散步时，偶然遇到了一位人形混血生物。他对她了解得越多，疯狂与疑惧便越发滋长，而她不打算放他离开。

[摘自[url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/hiking-kemonomimi]Itch.io[/url]]
